string.name: EntryAbility_desc
string.value: Connect to OpenBitFun desktop and control remote sessions

string.name: permission_microphone_reason
string.value: Used to turn speech into text to send in a conversation.

string.name: permission_distributed_datasync_reason
string.value: Used to authorize a watch on the same GitHub account using a separate device credential.

string.name: remoteDesktop_approvalRequired
string.value: Allow this device to view the display in the computer’s local settings first.

string.name: remoteDesktop_permissionRequired
string.value: Enable screen recording permission on the computer.

string.name: remoteDesktop_hostLocked
string.value: The computer is locked or its desktop session is unavailable. Restore it locally, then reconnect.

string.name: remoteDesktop_updateRequired
string.value: The relay needs remote desktop support enabled.

string.name: remoteDesktop_unsupported
string.value: This computer cannot share its display yet.

string.name: remoteDesktop_connectionFailed
string.value: The connection ended. Return to the device list and try again.

string.name: remoteDesktop_controlUnsupported
string.value: Keyboard and mouse control is not available on this computer yet.

string.name: remoteDesktop_controlBusy
string.value: AI or another operation is using the computer. Stop it on the computer before retrying.

string.name: remoteDesktop_controlApprovalRequired
string.value: Allow this device to operate the selected display in the computer’s local settings first.

string.name: remoteDesktop_controlPaused
string.value: Control paused. Start control again; previous input will not be replayed.

string.name: remoteDesktop_textPlaceholder
string.value: Type here, then send to the computer

string.name: remoteDesktop_keyboardHint
string.value: Types into the selected field on the computer

string.name: remoteDesktop_keyboardUnavailable
string.value: The remote keyboard paused. Use More → Resume control to retry.

string.name: remoteDesktop_screenshotFailed
string.value: Could not capture or save the image. Please retry.

string.name: remoteDesktop_tapHint
string.value: In direct touch mode, tap to click. Double-tap and hold the second tap to drag.

string.name: remoteDesktop_textUnsupported
string.value: Text input is not available on this computer.

string.name: remoteDesktop_inputPermissionRequired
string.value: Grant the required system input permission locally on the computer, then retry.

string.name: remoteDesktop_rotationUnavailable
string.value: Unable to rotate the screen. Try turning your phone.

string.name: remoteDesktop_pauseHint
string.value: Screen sharing and control are paused. The connection is kept briefly. Resume viewing to reconnect and request control.

string.name: remoteDesktop_signalingInterrupted
string.value: Signaling interrupted. Control is paused; video is kept for up to 30 seconds while reconnecting.

string.name: remoteDesktop_displayUnavailable
string.value: This display is no longer available. Reconnect and select a display.

string.name: remoteDesktop_stage_waiting_for_host
string.value: Waiting for the previous share to end…

string.name: remoteDesktop_attachmentBusy
string.value: This computer is already being viewed. End the other connection, then reconnect.

string.name: remoteDesktop_cleanupPending
string.value: The computer is still ending the previous share. Reconnect shortly.

string.name: remoteDesktop_serviceDescription
string.value: Use your own remote desktop service, independently of OpenBitFun login. Each computer must approve this phone locally.

string.name: remoteDesktop_servicePairingHint
string.value: Required for first pairing. Leave blank to use saved device credentials. The pairing key is not saved.

string.name: remoteDesktop_serviceFailed
string.value: Unable to connect. Check the service address, pairing key and deployment status. Existing credentials have been kept.
